Our Story • আমাদের কথা

Preserving Kolkata's Culinary Soul Since 1998

Set inside a restored 1920s mansion on Park Street, Kolkata, Bengal Bite was founded by Chef Subhojit Chatterjee and his grandmother, Radharani Devi, with a singular dream: to bring the unhurried warmth of a traditional Bengali household kitchen (Rannaghor) to the city's dining table.

Whether it is the unmistakable aroma of aged Gobindobhog rice from Burdwan, fresh catch brought in at dawn from Kolaghat and Diamond Harbour, or clay pots of Mishti Doi set overnight in our Nalin Sarkar Street dairy, every dish honours centuries-old techniques without shortcuts.

Heirloom Spices

Stone-ground mustard, roasted poppy seeds & house-blended Bhaja Masala.

Kansa Tableware

Served on artisanal bell-metal platters crafted in Bankura & Bishnupur.

Warm Atithiyata

Heartfelt Bengali hospitality for family lunches, adda & festive feasts.
